title: Hosted API sovereignty mapper and evidence orchestrator for tenant residency assertions
creator: Priya Nair
description:
Problem: Customers require provable data residency guarantees for Hosted API requests plus an automated, tamper-evident evidence bundle for audits. Current region routing supports coarse geo-affinity but lacks a tenant-level policy DSL, deterministic routing enforcement, and a packaged evidentiary artifact that auditors trust.

Goal: Ship a lightweight ‘sovereignty mapper’ service and evidence orchestration pipeline that: (1) lets teams declare per-tenant residency profiles (region allowlist, preferred-region order, retention class), (2) enforces routing choices at the request gateway with deterministic fallback rules, (3) produces signed evidence bundles (request logs, routing decisions, retention policy applied, storage manifest) suitable for automated audit export.

Success metrics:
- 99.9% of requests for pinned tenants routed to tenant-allowed regions (with acceptable fallback telemetry)
- Evidence bundles generated within 10s of daily window and downloadable via Admin UI/API
- <5ms median added latency at gateway for policy evaluation
- Positive legal review for bundle contents and retention metadata
acceptance_criteria: Admin UI to create/edit residency profiles for tenants (region list, retention class, enforcement mode)
API endpoints to read/evaluate residency profile with caching and TTL
Gateway integration that consults sovereignty mapper with <10ms P50 lookup and deterministic fallback behavior
Evidence bundle schema v1 with signed manifest, request sample, routing logs, policy snapshot and storage manifest
Automated daily evidence export job that produces per-tenant ZIP and pushes to customer-specified S3/GCS/secure-transfer
RBAC and audit-logging for profile changes; stored change history for 180 days
notes:
Implementation trade-offs discussed in kickoff:
- Strong enforcement (hard pin) vs best-effort routing: decided to support both enforcement modes (hard and soft) to accommodate existing customers and new compliance-first tenants.
- Location metadata source: prefer cloud hypervisor locality + VPC region identity rather than IP-only heuristics to minimize misclassification.
- Evidence bundle cryptographic signing: use platform KMS to sign manifests; HSM option deferred to Private offering.

Open questions:
- Do we need per-route overrides for multi-tenant apps? (PM proposed later phase)
- Retention class mapping to storage tier and proof-of-deletion workflow — ops-to-design spike scheduled.
comments: 2025-03-02 — Scoping meeting with Legal (Marta Chen) and Security (Ravi Patel). Agreed required fields in evidence bundle and retention window expectations.

2025-03-04 — Eng design review: ENG proposed caching layer with 60s TTL and a fallback chain stored in mapper; latency estimate +3–7ms. Ava requested tighter P50 target; eng to prototype optimized lookup.

2025-03-06 — Design feedback: DES-1215 provided Admin UI wireframes for residency profile editor (region tags, enforcement toggle, retention dropdown). Minor adjustment to UX for displaying effective fallback sequence.
2025-03-08 — Security review kickoff: discussed KMS signing approach and S3 export hardening. Security requested threat model and proof-of-deletion plan before full rollout.

2025-03-10 — Decision: implement Evidence bundle v1 schema and routing enforcement modes in alpha. Create canary group of 5 tenants for initial validation. Planned PR: github.com/redwood-inference/sovereignty-mapper/pull/48
implementation_plan:
Phase 1: Mapper service + Admin UI + simple evidence bundle (v1) — scope 3 sprints.
Phase 2: Export connectors (S3/GCS/secure-transfer), retention enforcement, per-route overrides — next quarter.
Phase 3: HSM signing, on-prem evidence connector, WORM storage options — enterprise-only scope.

Rollout plan: alpha with internal + 5 partner tenants, monitor routing accuracy and bundle completeness for 2 weeks, then gradual ramp to GA with opt-in for enforcement modes.
risks:
- Misrouted requests during early rollout leading to compliance incidents (mitigate with canary + automatic rollback).
- Evidence bundle leakage if export config mis-set (mitigate with pre-flight validators and encryption-at-rest).
- Increased gateway latency if cache miss rate high (mitigate by edge caching and async evidence collection where possible).
